title: feat(service-automation,lint,spec,verify)!: the single-brace resolver and the legacy condition path are deleted — every condition is CEL, a value-slot literal is handed on as written (#19939 pass 4, S7)
body:
Fixes #19939
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Pass 4, stage S7 — the close-out of #19939: the single-brace `{…}` template dialect's resolver is deleted (ADR-0032 Sequencing 6: "delete the single-brace resolver"), with the engine's legacy condition path, the lint's mirror of the grammar, and the canon and pending release text that still described them. Every earlier stage (S1–S6) retired the dialect position by position; this one removes what was left reading it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
- 流程(flow)里不再有任何地方读旧的单花括号模板写法 `{…}`。负责解析这种写法的运行时代码被整段删除。
- 流程条件(启动条件、连线条件、分支条件、屏幕字段的显示条件)一律按 CEL 表达式求值。还写着 `{amount} > 100` 这类旧写法的条件会被明确拒绝，并告诉作者正确写法 `amount > 100`。
- 顺带修复一个隐蔽缺陷：代码里直接定义的流程如果把日期对象写进字段值，过去会被悄悄写成空对象 `{}`，现在原样写入。
- 校验工具(`os validate`)不再按旧写法报告问题，也不再在旧写法的位置给出旧写法的修改建议。
- 文档、示例和待发布的版本说明里，凡是"旧写法在某处仍然有效"的句子都已改成与现状一致。

**为什么改**
- 架构决策 ADR-0032 规定流程只保留一种模板分隔符 `{{ }}`，并要求删除单花括号解析器。S1–S6 已经逐个位置把旧写法退役，解析器只剩两处只会看到普通字面量的调用，以及一段已注册流程根本走不到的条件旧路径。
- 两种方言并存，正是 AI 和人写流程时最容易混用、出错又不报错的地方。删掉后只剩一种写法，写错会被大声拒绝。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 影响面：已注册的流程不受影响，因为注册时本来就拒绝旧写法的条件。受影响的只有直接调用引擎条件求值方法的代码(插件、`@objectstack/verify` 的测试入口)：旧写法从"按文本比较"变为报错。本仓库源码、示例和文档里没有这类调用。
- `@objectstack/lint` 移除 4 个导出(旧语法的分类工具)。本仓库和 objectui 都没有引用。
- HotCRM 仍有 294 处旧写法分布在 28 个源码文件里，这些位置在 S1–S6 已被拒绝，需要在 HotCRM 下次升级依赖版本时一并迁移(本 PR 不改 HotCRM)。
- 改动规模：53 个文件，+867 / −2451，共 3318 行，其中约三分之二是删除。超过 3000 行，不能走自动合并队列。
- 回滚：整 PR revert 即可恢复解析器和条件旧路径。没有数据迁移，也没有存储格式变化。

**席位意见**

**你要做的(一个动作)**
- 本 PR 超过 3000 行，需要一位有授权的账号(os-zhuang 或 hotlong)在 PR 上点 Approve。点完后由席位负责合并。

## What changes

- **The resolver.** `service-automation`'s `builtin/template.ts` loses `interpolate`, `interpolateString`, `resolveToken`, the value-expression function table and `FlowExpressionFunctionError` (none was a package export), with their four unit-test files (`template-array-index`, `template-date-offset-dst`, `template-functions`, `template-object-token`). The file keeps the text-slot renderer (`renderTextSlot`, `textTemplateScope`, `FlowTextTemplateError`).
- **Its two remaining callers.** `value-slot-map.ts` `resolveValueSlot` (the literal arm every value slot shares) and the `assignment` executor (`logic-nodes.ts`, all three shapes) saw literals only, since the value-slot judge refuses every token. They hand on `copyLiteral(value)`: arrays and plain objects copied, every other value as it is. That fixes `interpolate()` writing a `Date` as `{}` (stage plan `6096263424`'s S7 item), pinned through `registerFlow` + `execute` on the three `assignment` shapes and on `create_record` / `update_record`.
- **The legacy condition path.** `AutomationEngine.evaluateCondition` loses the template branch, its hole discriminator, and its text comparison (`TEMPLATE_HOLE`, `templateHoles`, `refuseUnresolvedTemplateHole`, `refuseUnresolvedCelOperand`, `compareValues`, `unquoteLiteral`). Every condition is CEL. A braced string is refused as the CEL brace trap, naming its source. A `template` or `flow` envelope is refused before evaluation. Measured first: `registerFlow` refused all 12 condition spellings probed (start, edge, decision, `visibleWhen`, `wait`; bare braced strings and `template` / `flow` envelopes), so only a direct call reached the path.
- **The lint.** `validateFlowTemplatePaths` reads `{{ }}` holes only and skips a CRUD node's `filter` operands (value slots since S6), so its filter-position `error` and every finding on a single-brace token are gone. The value-slot and text-slot judges refuse those tokens as `expression-invalid`. Its 14 single-brace filter fixtures and the reference-integrity suite's one are re-judged. `flow-double-brace-interpolation` and `flow-bare-dollar-reference`, at a string outside every slot and literal, say the value is read as written instead of prescribing a single-brace token. `flow-template-grammar.ts`, the lint's mirror of the deleted grammar (its test read `template.ts` from disk), is deleted with its four exports.
- **The canon.** The `FlowSchema` example's `connector_action` input holds a literal, since nothing reads a token there and no connector-input value slot is built. The step-18 registry text: the text-slot entry says no other flow string reads the dialect, and the value-slot entry (`flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused`, order 88) names every value slot S1–S6 retired, where it named only pass 1's. `flow-template-token.ts` is now the judges' frozen reading of a retired grammar. Docblocks in `flow-text-slot-template.ts`, `builtin-node-config.zod.ts` and `data/context-tokens.zod.ts` are updated, with their two reference pages regenerated. Also updated: the verify handle's doc, a formula stdlib comment, and the flows guide's paragraph that still taught a `{var}` condition.

## FROM → TO

| you wrote | write instead | what changes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `engine.evaluateCondition('{amount} > 100', vars)` | `engine.evaluateCondition('amount > 100', vars)` | the template substituted text and compared it; CEL compares the values and fails the run on an absent variable |
| `"{status} == 'open'"`, `'{status} == open'` | `"status == 'open'"` | a string literal is quoted |
| `{ dialect: 'template', source: "{flag} == true" }`, `dialect: 'flow'` | `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'flag == true' }` | — |
| `classifyFlowTemplateToken(inner)` (`@objectstack/lint`) | `valueSlotTemplateRefusals(value)` / `textSlotTemplateRefusal(text)` (`@objectstack/spec/automation`), which refuse a token with the spelling that replaces it | the grammar it classified is read by nothing |
| `FLOW_TEMPLATE_DATE_FUNCTIONS`, `FLOW_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FUNCTIONS` | the CEL stdlib: `isoDate(today())`, `isoDatetime(now())`, `round`, `floor`, `ceil`, `abs`, `min`, `max` | — |
| `FlowTemplateTokenVerdict` | nothing: the judges' reading of the retired grammar is internal to `@objectstack/spec` | — |

The retired `flow-filter-token-unknown` rule (S6) gets its own FROM → TO in its changeset, corrected below: rule id `flow-filter-token-unknown` → `expression-invalid` (`EXPRESSION_INVALID`); `validateFlowFilterTokens(stack)` → `validateStackExpressions(stack)`; `FlowFilterTokenFinding` → `ExprIssue`; `FLOW_FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` → `EXPRESSION_INVALID`.

The new changeset is `.changeset/19939-flow-single-brace-resolver-deleted.md`. Bumps: `@objectstack/service-automation` major, `@objectstack/lint` major, `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/verify` patch. ADR-0087 disposition: not required, already registered (`flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused`, `flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused`), accepted by `check-adr-0087-registration`.

## `check-empty-changeset` is red on purpose: DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` refuses a diff that modifies a changeset present on the merge base. It names two classes with opposite remedies. COLLISION means restore theirs and rename yours. DELIBERATE CORRECTION means "do NOT restore it — say so on the PR and get it confirmed". This PR is the second class for all 15 files, exactly as #23126 was: each file is a release note that a later landing on the `next` train made false (S6, `615c696046`) or that this PR makes false. Nothing is restored to turn the gate green. It stays red (exit 1, 15 `::error` lines, one per file) until the at-tier contract review on this head confirms the correction.

**What moved since #23126.** The Version Packages PR #21988 merged as `d889448b9` and `18.0.0-next.0` is on npm (`next` dist-tag). That cut consumed every pending changeset into `.changeset/pre/`, which is where these 15 corrections now sit. They still decide published text. In `@changesets/cli` 3.0.3, `assemble-release-plan` drops `pre/` changesets only while pre mode is not `exit`. So the GA cut that exits pre mode reads them, and the `18.0.0` CHANGELOG entry is built from the corrected sentences. The `18.0.0-next.0` CHANGELOG entries already carry the S6-falsified sentences. Those are released entries, and AGENTS.md routes their amendment to a dedicated docs-only PR, never a rider here. That amendment is the seat's carry.

**Why each in-place-fix condition holds.** (1) Same defect class: every file is pending or prerelease text describing the single-brace dialect, or the retired `flow-filter-token-unknown`, as still live. (2) Mechanical, with its shape pinned by #23126, which edited the identical "keeps resolving where it still lives" sentences in place. (3) No other claim holds these files: #22586 is closed, and the next Version Packages refresh regenerates from `main`. (4) The same gate family, with no new verification surface.

The measured lengths slice 10 states (at most 194; 222 to 441) still hold for its nine remaining ids: PR #22828's table puts `flow-filter-token-unknown` at 267–278 → 181–192.

## Acceptance notes

- **HotCRM, for its next pin bump.** Census at hotcrm `0f84c9c` (read only): a TS-AST walk of 494 code files, judged with the spec's own classifiers (`classifyFlowFilterOperandString`, the frozen token grammar). In `src`, 294 strings carry a single-brace token at positions #19939 retired, in 28 files: `fields.*` 94, CRUD filter operands 71 (none a query placeholder), notify `templateData.*` 35, http `body` 34, notify `recipients` 19, notify `actionUrl` 19, loop `collection` 10, `assignments.*` 6, subflow `input.*` 5, screen `description` 1. Most are paths (about 260), with 26 date macros and 7 `$User` paths. There are none at the positions S7 itself retires: 0 braced conditions, 0 `connector_action` inputs. Tests add 14 more. The seat records this on its ledger.
- **objectui** (companion card, filed by the seat): the designer still teaches the single brace. See `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` :690 and :706 (collection placeholders, `refMode: 'template'`) and `json-schema-to-fields.ts` :259 and :295. The simulator re-implements the deleted interpolator (`previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts` :455–581). The pinned console imports none of the removed lint exports (git grep exit 1; control exit 0), so the Console Pin Gate is not tripped.
- **Noted, not filed:** the header of `packages/formula/src/stdlib-timestamp-text.test.ts` still describes the deleted `resolveToken` / `interpolateString` in the present tense; its pinned bytes stay valid as a frozen record of what they measured. Carrier: none.
- **Not in this PR, by the seat's call:** the #21898 token carve-out (`builtinValueJudged` / `carriesInterpolationToken`). A `get_record` with `limit: '{x}'` registers, and every run refuses it (probe). The seat files it as this family's tail card.

## Verification

All at head `05539d423` (`origin/main` `01a3421f4` merged through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, plus one fold commit), unless stated. Measured size: 53 files, +867 / −2451 = 3318 changed lines against `main`, generated files included.

- **Merge and fold.** `b1f1c0ffc` merges `origin/main` `01a3421f4` with a merge commit, through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`: no conflict, nothing regenerated by hand. That merge brought in the `18.0.0-next.0` cut, which is what moved the 15 corrected files under `.changeset/pre/`. `05539d423` folds S7's canon fix: the order-88 rationale fragment in `registry.ts.template`, plus one sentence in the new changeset. The fragment's projections (`registry.ts`, the upgrade-guide pages, `spec-changes.json`) are gitignored build output, so nothing committed derives from it. The full build regenerates them, and `check:generated`, `check:upgrade-guide` and `step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` read them green.
- **Build.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2`, under the verify lock: 74 successful, 74 total. The full dist closure is what makes `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` measured (exit 0) rather than exit 3.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, on `05539d423` derives 114 commands. Each ran once, with its exit code captured before any pipe.
  - 113 exit 0, among them `check:authorable-surface`, `check:generated`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
  - 1 exit 1: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, with 15 `::error` lines. This is by design, as described above.
  - `--ran` reports: "114 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 114 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- **Suites**, on the merged head, under the lock:
  - `@objectstack/service-automation`: 185 files, 2449 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/lint`: 137 files, 6662 tests.
  - `@objectstack/verify`: 38 files, 301 tests.
  - `@objectstack/spec`: `src/automation src/migrations src/data/context-tokens` 41 files, 1806 tests; `--project repo scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` 1 file, 9 tests.
  - `turbo run typecheck` on service-automation, lint, verify, formula and spec: 53 successful, 53 total.
- **Downstream consumer sweep.** Prefix direction: `...@objectstack/service-automation`, `...@objectstack/lint` and `...@objectstack/verify` together give 55 packages. Each package ran alone with `--maxWorkers=2`, all exit 0:
  - metadata-protocol: 233 files passed, 3 skipped; 28284 tests passed, 19 skipped.
  - objectql: 412 files, 8041 tests.
  - plugin-approvals: 74 files, 1051 tests.
  - trigger-record-change: 11 files, 114 tests.
  - trigger-schedule: 8 files, 174 tests.
  - example-crm: 6 files, 46 tests.
  - example-showcase: 33 files, 409 tests.
  - example-todo: 7 files, 238 tests.
  - `@objectstack/cli --project unit`: 285 files, 4283 tests.

  The cli integration tier is declared to CI, since the diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry. The four removed lint exports have zero hits in the tree (`git grep` exit 1; control exit 0), and the full build compiles every package's declarations.

  NOT MEASURED locally: the other 43 packages of the closure. The reason is the shared container: a first, single turbo run of the sweep was SIGKILLed (exit 137) inside metadata-protocol while the gate battery ran beside it. A `git grep` over those 43 finds no `evaluateCondition` call, no deleted-symbol or `flow-template-*` reference, and no interpolator call. The only hits are service-messaging's own `{{ }}` renderer and prose in the dogfood ledger. CI runs them.
- **Ablations**, at `56811ae93`. The three mutated files and five test files are byte-identical at `05539d423` (`git diff --quiet` exit 0); the suites above re-ran green on the merged head, and the ablations were not re-run there. Each used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode under the lock: anchor hits 1 then 0, a blob change proven, then restore with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, plus a shell trap that restores HEAD by absolute path with a `hash-object` check.

- **ESLint, a measured narrowing** at `05539d423`: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 47 changed, non-deleted files, read off eslint's own JSON. 27 files are linted with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The other 20 (16 md, 3 mdx, 1 `.template`) are ignored by the config. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so the diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
